module.purpose: Provides the settings route for displaying and configuring the appearance of an individual team's booking page, while generating localized page metadata.
module.summary: This route module bridges the application settings hierarchy to a legacy team-appearance view. It asynchronously resolves localized translation resources, uses the team identifier to construct metadata URLs, and renders the legacy content within the shared settings header with matching localized title and description.
module.businessContext: Supports team administrators configuring booking-page appearance. If it fails, the team appearance settings route loses its localized shell or legacy configuration view.
functions: generateMetadata (~L6-13): Builds localized metadata for the team's appearance settings route
Page (~L15-26): Renders localized settings header around the legacy appearance view

units.name: generateMetadata
units.source:
export const generateMetadata = async ({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) =>
  await _generateMetadata(
    (t) => t("booking_appearance"),
    (t) => t("appearance_team_description"),
    undefined,
    undefined,
    `/settings/organizations/teams/other/${(await params).id}/appearance`
  );
